subject: Hybrid spillover economics & ops: Pinecone + S3 fallback retainer
messages:
From: Alyssa Trent <alyssa@pinecone.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: storage-team@pinecone.io
Date: 2026-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: S3 fallthrough economics + ops retainer

Hi Monica / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Pinecone can accept a tiered spillover model that routes cold queries to S3-backed indices; we put together a quick cost model and an ops retainer outline to help quantify cost and responsibility split.

Summary (high level):
- Measured token cost delta when falling back to S3 vs in-memory vector retrieval (sample workload attached).
- Suggested retainer covers: index rehydration SLA, TTL policy harmonization, and escalation playbook for query failures.
- Commercial asks: monthly retainer + per-GB read surcharge.

Action items we propose now:
1) Redwood to share representative query profile (qps distribution, cold-hit fraction) — helps us run the model against your workload.
2) Joint technical review of rehydration cadence and TTL enforcement.
3) Legal to map data-residency obligations for cold spills.

I've attached pinecone_s3_backfill_model.xlsx (spreadsheet of back-of-envelope numbers). Let us know if you want a walkthrough — happy to demo the assumptions.

Best,
Alyssa
Business Development, Pinecone

Attachment: pinecone_s3_backfill_model.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Trent <alyssa@pinecone.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: S3 fallthrough economics + ops retainer

Thanks Alyssa — useful framing. Looping in Vanessa and Ben for ops/commercial alignment.

Quick response and next steps from our side:
- We can share a sampled query profile by EOD Monday (will include qps percentiles, cold-hit rate, and average vector size).
- From an ops perspective we want to validate two modes: (a) read-through with async rehydrate, (b) QPS-driven on-demand rehydrate. Please flag assumptions in your model for each.
- Proposed scope for a 3-month retainer pilot: 8 hours/month of joint runbook engineering + an SLA for 2h median rehydrate window for indexed shards. Commercials we can discuss after the profile run.

I've attached a short scoping doc to capture the pilot boundaries. Can we schedule a 60-minute technical sync next week (Tue/Wed pref)?

Thanks — Monica
Director, EmbedOps (Redwood Inference)

Attachment: hybrid-spillover-scoping.docx (docx, 28KB)

Summary: Pinecone sent a cost model and sampled workload. They propose a retainer + per-GB read surcharge to cover rehydration and operational overhead for S3 fallback queries. Attached materials are the vendor model + workload extract.

Immediate asks for Redwood:
- Karthik: build a quick sensitivity matrix (3 scenarios: 5%, 15%, 30% cold-hit) showing monthly cost delta and per-query latency tail. Need by Tue EOD to prep for pricing.
- Vanessa: ops lead — prepare a draft runbook for rehydrate flow and incident escalation; include who owns initial retries, backoff, and monitoring signals.
- Monica: finalize pilot scope doc and confirm the 60-min tech sync (Monica to send calendar confirmation).

Also flagged for Legal & Finance: depending on the sensitivity of spilled vectors we may need to review data-residency clauses; if Pinecone processes spill data in a different region we may require encryption-at-rest + KMS mapping in the SLA.
